paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2 units. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 20 units. The plot features three distinct lines. The first line, representing the "3-Model Ensemble," is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at 85 reliability at a cost of 0 and decreases slightly to approximately 80 at a cost of 5, then further decreases to approximately 75 at 10. The second line, representing the "2-Model Ensemble," is red with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at around 88 and decreases steadily to approximately 85 at the cost of 5, and finishes at about 74 at the cost of 10. Lastly, the "GPT-4" line is yellow with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at about 90 and showing a more pronounced decrease to around 65 at the cost of 5 and to about 40 at the cost of 10. The yellow line intersects the blue and red lines at the cost of 2, and the blue line intersects the red line at x=5. There are legends provided on top of the plot map, each line color corresponding to its label.
